<!-- pr-reviewer: 7eba7a96bbb7f0b17213ac52e00aabf6345d301e -->
**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** The PR changes process text only. I read it; I did not build it.

**What looks good**
- The rule is the same in every place it appears: the two labels never coexist; whoever sets one removes the other in one `gh pr edit` call with one comment; an open change request wins (`needs-rework` stays, `merge-ready` goes); `conflicts` stays add-alongside. Checked at `AGENTS.md:409-416` and `AGENTS.md:440-441`, `.claude/skills/merge-ready/SKILL.md:115-127`, `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:133-136` and `:169-180`, `.claude/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md:175-177`, `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md:222-231`.
- The old "disagreement: no agent removes a label" text is fully gone. A grep for it at the head finds nothing in `AGENTS.md`, the skills or the agents.
- The `merge-ready` drop-list bullet was updated with the rule, so the skill cannot offer a PR with `needs-rework`.
- Process-law checks pass: `Process change: yes` is in the body; `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not in the diff (still 129 at the head); no code, no `.github/`, no scripts, no `xtask/`, no dependency changes. No test pins the old text.
- Form passes: conventional subject `docs(process): ...`, commit body ends `Fixes #3382`, `Changelog: none`, body is complete. The diff merges clean with current `main` (`a47c7ff22`).

**Results**
- Read-only review as agreed for a text-only process PR: no build, no suites, no clippy. Nothing in the diff maps to a test or a heavy lane (`cargo xtask gate` maps code, and there is no code change).

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:136` (unchanged line): a "Not built" review adds `needs-maintainer` and removes `merge-ready` and `needs-rework`. If a collaborator's change request is open on that head, this line now removes their `needs-rework`, while the new rule says an open change request wins. The old text also had this gap. A follow-up can say whether `needs-maintainer` replaces a live `needs-rework` or sits beside it.
2. `AGENTS.md:412`: "one set `merge-ready`" reads better as "one has set `merge-ready`" (present perfect for a past action with a now-effect). Trivial.
3. `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md:228-229`: in the disagreement branch the reviewer only removes `merge-ready`; the flag example (`--add-label needs-rework ...`) fits the blockers branch. A reader may mix the two. Optional clarity fix.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7eba7a96bbb7f0b17213ac52e00aabf6345d301e -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- The rule is stated with the same words in every file: `merge-ready` and `needs-rework` are never on the same PR; the setter of one removes the other in the same `gh pr edit` call, with one comment that says why.
- The precedence is identical in all five files: an open change request wins; `needs-rework` stays; `merge-ready` goes; the comment goes to the collaborator who set `merge-ready` (AGENTS.md "Only collaborators' reviews count"; `.claude/skills/merge-ready/SKILL.md:115-126`; `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:169-179`; `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md:221-232`; `.claude/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md:175-177`).
- The old "disagreement: no agent removes a label" prose is fully gone: a search of the head for `no agent removes` and `is a disagreement` hits nothing outside the removed hunks.
- `conflicts` stays add-alongside in every place, so the new rule does not change it.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited. The diff is text in five process files only: no code, no `.github/`, no scripts, no dependencies, no `xtask/`.
- Process law: the body says `Process change: yes`, has `Changelog: none`, and ends `Fixes #3382`. The commit subject is conventional (`docs(process): merge-ready and needs-rework never coexist`).

## Results
- Not built: the diff changes process text only. No suite maps to it, and no `xtask` file pins the old wording. Read-only review, as the quick pass stated.
- `gh pr view --json mergeable` (2026-11-22T11:4xZ): `MERGEABLE` against current `main` (head `7eba7a96b`, one commit).

## Heavy lanes
- The diff reaches no heavy lane (markdown only).

## Requested before merge
- None.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. "Keep/stays `needs-rework`" vs the add command: in the disagreement case the prose says `needs-rework` stays (AGENTS.md line 414, `.claude/skills/merge-ready/SKILL.md:125`), while the given command is `--add-label needs-rework --remove-label merge-ready`. The resulting label state is the same (add is a no-op when the label is already there), so this is only wording. A later touch could say "make sure `needs-rework` is set" once.
2. Pre-existing edge, not introduced here: the "Not built" row of `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:136` removes `needs-rework` when it adds `needs-maintainer`. If another collaborator's change request is still open, that removal now conflicts with "an open change request wins". Consider one follow-up clause there. Not a blocker for this PR.
3. Style: most added sentences obey ASD-STE100. The sentence "The person or agent that sets one of them removes the other ... then posts one comment that says why" carries two instructions in one sentence; the AGENTS.md version splits it correctly. Cosmetic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
